profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI-Enabled SaaS Platforms | Cloud Architecture | 20+ Years of Engineering Experience
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer & Owner @ AVAIA | AI-Enabled SaaS Platforms & Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
I build software from the ground up, taking ideas from early concepts through architecture, implementation, and deployment.

My experience spans the full engineering lifecycle, including system architecture, full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, security, enterprise integration, and deployment. I’m equally comfortable working through system-level decisions and getting hands-on with the implementation.

AI has changed the speed and scale at which software can be built, but not the fundamentals. I use it as an execution multiplier, guided by more than 20 years of engineering experience and the judgment that comes from building systems across both enterprise environments and independent projects.

My focus today is on AI-enabled platforms, agentic systems, cloud architecture, and solving practical business problems through software.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Owner @ AVAIA | AI-Enabled SaaS Platforms & Cloud Architecture
positions.description:
AVAIA is my independent software engineering practice, where I design and build AI-enabled SaaS platforms from the ground up.

Work spans the full engineering lifecycle, from system architecture and application development to cloud infrastructure, security, integrations, and deployment. I use AI extensively throughout the engineering process to increase execution capacity while keeping architecture and implementation decisions grounded in engineering judgment and experience.

Platforms include:

ReservaLive (www.reservalive.com) - Event and venue reservation platform
ReservaHome (www.reservahome.com) - Direct-booking platform for vacation rentals
LocalTrial (www.localtrial.com) - Clinical trial recruitment platform
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Prompt Engineering · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Enterprise Architecture · Cloud Computing · Enterprise Software · AI Consulting

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform
positions.description:
Contributed to the foundational architecture and platform patterns behind Bryte 2.0, supporting UKG’s transition to a more scalable MCP-based AI agent framework leveraging Google ADK.

- Architected and implemented an MCP-based framework that streamlined tool development and accelerated AI capability delivery

- Designed and implemented a queryable tool architecture leveraging predicates and aggregations, expanding LLM capability coverage without requiring additional tooling

- Standardized reusable integration and tooling patterns that reduced cross-team coordination overhead and eliminated repeated engineering cycles

- Influenced architectural decisions and implementation strategies across multiple engineering teams

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Engineering & Enterprise Integration
positions.description:
Designed and built containerized microservices that served as a centralized integration and session orchestration layer between legacy systems and modern applications, enabling unified proxied access to data and powering the modern experience within UKG products.

- Brokered authentication and session management across systems by validating JWT and legacy tokens, resolving legacy sessions, and mapping authenticated requests to downstream services

- Implemented Redis-based session caching and MongoDB-backed tenant/user management to optimize request routing and reduce authentication overhead

- Proxied and orchestrated requests across multi-tenant WFM environments, dynamically routing traffic to tenant-specific systems using resolved legacy sessions for authentication

- Reduced frontend and service coupling by exposing legacy systems through a consistent integration layer consumed across multiple applications and services

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained software platforms supporting Subway’s global franchise operations. Software included:

- A cloud-based RESTful data service framework supporting 40,000+ franchises all over 100+ countries and processing millions of transactions per day.

- An MVVM Silverlight front-end application with over 10 administrative modules supporting menu management, taxation, and menu deployment operations for franchisees and global support teams.

- A set of API Client Libraries exposing data synchronization and menu deployment functionality to Point of Sale (POS) software installed at restaurant endpoints.

- A modern web-based mobile front-end primarily designed for monitoring system status and performing critical maintenance functions.

- A web-based application for visually designing, deploying, and managing the data distribution and integration components of our Integration Platform as a Service (IPaaS) solution.

Technologies used: C#, SQL Server 2016, SQL Management Object (SMO), AWS - Amazon
Web Services (API Gateway, Lambda, SES, SNS, SQS, Amazon Connect), Silverlight, Aurelia,
Webpack, Typescript, Javascript, Git, Node.js, NPM,

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained software solutions to support call center operations. Examples
include:

- A lead management system integrated with call center dialer components supporting the
import/export, classification, management, and distribution of client leads.

- A reporting framework with 20+ reports using Microsoft Reporting Services designed to
enable efficiency in managing campaigns and staff.

- A data aggregation and distribution solution which included 30+ SQL Server jobs and
SSIS packages designed to support data synchronization, client data (return file)
delivery, and call center automation requirements.

Technologies used: .Net Platform 2.0-3.5, C# 2.0-3.0, LINQ, ASP.Net, MS SQL Server 2005,
SyBase, SQL Management Object (SMO), MS SQL Server Integration Services, DTS, MS
Reporting Services, MS Jet Database Engine, OLEDB, ODBC.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and Improved the Tel3.com network of sites, dedicated to supporting prepaid VOIP
services. Sites included:

- Tel3.com
- Tel3advantage.com
- Voipnet.com

Technologies used: ASP.Net 2.0, C#, JavaScript, SQL Server, Reporting Services.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained 100+ websites for real estate agents.
